stop_after.title: Stop after
stop_after.description: Every stage from this pipeline's starting point runs in one go, through quantification by default. Stop earlier to review or edit an intermediate result (e.g. the conversion plan, or masks before quantifying), then continue from that dataset with the matching 'Run from ...' pipeline.

model_dataset.title: Segment: custom model (optional)
model_dataset.description: Leave blank to use 'Model family' below. To run a self-trained model not published through astril's model manifest, upload its directory (its pipeline.json plus checkpoints) as a 'Files' dataset and select it here -- it then takes precedence over 'Model family'.

model_family.title: Segment: model family
model_family.description: A model family registered in astril's models.json. Ignored if a custom model is selected above. This dropdown is a static list, not a live registry lookup -- add a new family here by hand when one is added to astril's models.json.

seg_filename_pattern.title: Segmentation filename pattern
seg_filename_pattern.description: Suffix segmentation writes, and quantify looks for.

labels_json_dataset.title: Quantify: labels contract (optional)
labels_json_dataset.description: Rarely needed: masks produced by this pipeline's segmentation carry their labels in a segmentation_provenance.json sidecar. Needed only for masks without one (e.g. produced elsewhere) when 'Number of segmentation levels' isn't set: upload a labels.json ({"labels": {"1": "...", ...}}) as a 'Files' dataset (exactly one .json) and select it here.

quantify_n_threads.title: Quantify: threads
quantify_n_threads.description: File I/O parallelism across the whole run. Leave blank to use the task's allocated CPU count (recommended); set only to override.
